values.note: Park Alert: 'As we widen and repave our perimeter road, the park will be closed through October 31.' The park page lists every day as Closed.

status.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/parklocations?park=easterlin-park ('Park Alert As we widen and repave our perimeter road, the park will be closed through October 31. We appreciate your patience.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Broward County campsite fee $50 per site per night plus applicable taxes; includes park admission and the dump station. Dump station $20 for non-campers. Stays under 14 days are paid in full when booked.

fees.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees (Camping, updated Dec 29, 2025: 'a. Site Fee Includes park admission fee and use of sanitary dump stations where available. 1. Per Site, Per Night $50', 'Campground site rentals are subject to all applicable taxes'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('Easterlin (954-357-5190; EasterlinPark@Broward.org; 45 full hook-up RV sites; 10 additional sites)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 45 full-hookup RV sites and 10 additional sites; Easterlin also accepts tent camping. One camping unit and one vehicle per reservation, plus one more vehicle, motorcycle or trailer per site; up to eight people.

sites.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('45 full hook-up RV sites; 10 additional sites', Campground Rules: RESERVATIONS, VEHICLES, MAXIMUM CAPACITY) + https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees ('In addition to RVs, Easterlin and Markham parks accept tent camping'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Restroom complexes with hot showers, laundry room, Wi-Fi (ask the park office where), after-hours security, campground host.

facilities.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping (Campground Amenities: 'Restroom complexes with hot showers', 'Sanitary dumpstations', 'Wi-Fi access (check with Park Office for access locations)', 'Laundry rooms (C.B. Smith, Easterlin, and T.Y. park campgrounds only)'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('The campgrounds at C.B. Smith Park ..., Easterlin ..., Markham Park ..., and T.Y. ... Park ... are open year-round', 'Camping fees apply year-round'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Campground reservations must be made by calling or emailing the park office directly' (954-357-5190, EasterlinPark@Broward.org; office 9 a.m.-5 p.m. daily); payment only at park offices or Pay Online. Reservations highly recommended. RV sites allow extended stays of up to 180 days in 365 when available; tent camping 14 days. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m. Cancellations in writing.

booking.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping (General Information; Camping Fees: 'Reservations are highly recommended'; Campground Rules: MAXIMUM STAY LENGTH, CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT, CANCELLATION/TRANSFERS) + https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees ('extended stays are allowed for up to 180 days for RV sites, and 14 days for tent camping'), read 2026-10-21

note: Broward County Parks campground in Easterlin Regional Park, a heavily wooded inland park (a Designated Urban Wilderness Area with 250-year-old cypress) in Oakland Park. Paved sites; tight loop turns for big rigs. --Claude
summary: County camping and fee pages: confirmed full hookups (water/sewer), showers/laundry/Wi-Fi/dump, phone/email reservations; added the $50 site fee (plus tax), year-round season, 180-night RV max stay, and a temporary closure (park closed through October 31 for perimeter-road repaving). Changed site count 51 -> 55 (45 full-hookup + 10 additional). Not stated by the county: amperage (50 derived from the note, left), max rig length (40 from the note, left).
flags: Temporary closure recorded: the park page's alert says the park is closed through October 31 for road widening and repaving (not a storm closure); re-check the status after November 1, 2026.
